name: eps Ind B
how_to_read: Last visit minus first visit. Red = brighter now, blue = brighter before. Objects that did not move cancel out; a moving object leaves a blue spot (where it was) next to a red spot (where it is now).
pixel_note: Pixel (0,0) is the bottom-left sky pixel; each sky pixel is 10x10 PNG pixels; north is up and east is left, as in the frames.
data_credit: NASA SPHEREx via NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA)
